spriteGenerator.intro: Using the generator below you can create a base sprite image for a pony character with the colors and features of your choosing.
spriteGenerator.instructions: Once you download the base, you can use any drawing software which supports pixel-perfect editing, such as MS Paint, <paintNet>Paint.NET</paintNet>, or <gimp>Gimp</gimp> to customize the mane and tail to match your character's design. The coat-colored space on the top right is reserved for the cutie mark, if any.
